change_summary: Shorten each tool description to its first sentence before returning to LLM.
reason_for_change: Trimming verbose tool descriptions cuts prompt tokens sent every assistant generation while preserving tool schemas, directly lowering average token usage per turn with no impact on task success.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — crossed success guardrail: pass_rate 0.5833 < floor 0.5938
hypothesis: Shortening each tool description to a single sentence (name + verb phrase) while leaving the JSON schema intact will shrink the tools payload sent every turn, saving tokens with no functional loss.
